name: Las Terrazas Resort
positioning: Beachfront resort of villas and residences with a private white sand beach on Ambergris Caye, near Hol Chan Marine Reserve
best_for: Families who want residences with kitchens and a calm, shallow private beach
Snorkelers and divers who want to be near Hol Chan Marine Reserve and the Belize Barrier Reef

facts.text: Las Terrazas is a beachfront resort on Ambergris Caye in San Pedro, Belize.
The resort is near Hol Chan Marine Reserve.
The resort has an infinity pool.
Every residence includes a full kitchen or kitchenette.
The Luxury Lagoon Villa faces west, with lagoon sunsets and an open-air terrace.
The resort has the Serenity Spa.
Guests can bring their catch and the chef prepares it to order.
The private beach has calm, shallow water, and the main pool has a gradual entry.
Cribs, high chairs and pack-and-plays can be arranged on request.
The resort team can help book snorkeling, diving, fishing and mainland excursions.
Las Terrazas is part of the LVX Collection of Preferred Hotels.

highlights.text: The Beach Front Villa sits on the beach, has ocean views and comes with butler service.
The Penthouse has a private plunge pool on its balcony.
The Terrazas Luxury Villa has a private rooftop jacuzzi.
Guests can kayak at sunrise and watch the sunset from the Sky Lounge.
A PADI Open Water certification offered through the resort starts at the resort pool and finishes on the Belize Barrier Reef.

considerations.text: There are no rental cars on Ambergris Caye; the island runs on golf carts, and the resort can arrange a golf cart rental.
Sargassum seaweed can appear seasonally; the team maintains the beach daily.
Green season, May to October, brings warmer weather and occasional rain, but fewer crowds.

sources.title: Las Terrazas Resort - Luxury Beachfront Resort in Ambergris Caye
